brief: Indian shares opened higher on foreign inflows as the global AI-trade reversal continues, with IT stocks like TCS and Tech Mahindra rallying and US futures rebounding. Metals remain volatile after a week of mayhem, and Tata Steel fell nearly 5% on its APL Apollo Tubes deal.
